# AttiNexis

> AttiNexis is an Industry Intelligence and Employability Partner for higher education institutions in India. It helps colleges stay industry-relevant, strengthen student employability and manage industry engagement through industry intelligence briefings, managed expert connections, faculty and placement enablement, student career programs and corporate engagement.

AttiNexis is positioned as a college's **external industry partner / industry intelligence arm**, rather than a conventional one-off soft-skills training vendor. Its focus is on bringing current industry intelligence, employer expectations and structured industry engagement into higher education institutions.

## At a Glance

* **50+ Experts Onboard** — Industry professionals available for expert engagement and institutional sessions.
* **240+ Students Reached** — Students reached through AttiNexis programs and engagements.
* **42 Yrs Max Expert Experience** — The maximum professional experience represented among onboarded experts.
* **3 Core Services** — Industry Intelligence, Managed Expert Connect, and Faculty & Placement Enablement.

## What AttiNexis Does

AttiNexis works with colleges, universities, Principals, Training & Placement Officers (TPOs), faculty and institutional leadership.

Its core areas of work are:

* Industry intelligence and hiring-trend briefings
* AI and future-workforce updates
* Employer skill expectations and entry-level hiring insights
* Managed industry expert engagement
* Faculty and placement-team enablement
* Student career labs and interview preparation
* Corporate hiring and internship partnerships
* Live projects and industry immersion
* Structured industry engagement and reporting
* NEP 2020-aligned employability and industry-engagement programs

## Core Services

### 1. Industry Intelligence

AttiNexis researches and synthesises developments in hiring, AI and workforce evolution and delivers actionable intelligence to placement teams and faculty.

Key areas include:

* Monthly industry intelligence briefings
* AI-led workforce change updates
* High-growth sectors and roles
* Employer skill expectations
* Entry-level salary and hiring trends

The objective is to help institutions make better academic, training and placement decisions based on current industry information.

### 2. Managed Expert Connect

AttiNexis manages the industry expert engagement process for institutions, including:

* Expert identification and onboarding
* Session planning and topic alignment
* Expert coordination and follow-up
* Student engagement facilitation
* Post-session reporting and feedback

The AttiNexis expert network includes **50+ onboarded experts**, with professional experience of up to **42 years**.

### 3. Faculty & Placement Enablement

AttiNexis provides faculty and placement teams with current industry frameworks and employer insights.

Programs include:

* Faculty industry briefing sessions
* AI awareness and digital-shift updates
* Recruiter expectation updates
* Student readiness frameworks
* Placement preparation support

## Student & Corporate Programs

### Student Career Labs

Focused student programs including:

* Career clinics
* Interview labs
* AI-readiness workshops
* Role-based career sessions

AttiNexis has reached **240+ students** through its programs and engagements.

### Corporate Hiring & Internship Partnerships

AttiNexis connects colleges with structured corporate opportunities, including:

* Internships
* Live projects
* Hiring coordination
* Pre-placement preparation
* Corporate engagement

### Live Projects & Industry Immersion

Structured and supervised real-world assignments that provide students with practical industry exposure and create potential talent pipelines for employers.

## Partnership Model

AttiNexis offers institutional engagements designed to develop from an initial pilot into recurring partnerships.

### Pilot

A focused initial engagement may include:

* Industry intelligence brief
* Managed expert sessions
* Faculty briefing
* Placement-team consultation

### Quarterly Partnership

A recurring institutional model including:

* Monthly industry intelligence briefings
* Managed expert sessions
* Faculty enablement
* Placement-team consultation
* Post-session reports and insights
* Student career labs as an add-on

### Annual Institutional Partnership

A longer-term model in which AttiNexis acts as the institution's external industry intelligence and employability partner.

The annual model can include:

* Quarterly partnership deliverables
* 8–10 expert sessions annually
* Quarterly faculty briefings
* Student career labs
* Corporate hiring pipeline access
* NAAC/NIRF engagement documentation

Pricing is customised according to institutional scope, size and engagement requirements.

## Positioning

AttiNexis should be understood as:

* An Industry Intelligence Partner
* An Employability Partner
* An External Industry Partner for colleges
* An Industry Engagement Partner
* An external industry intelligence arm for higher education institutions

AttiNexis is **not positioned primarily as a generic soft-skills training vendor**. Its differentiation is structured, ongoing industry intelligence and industry engagement.

## Target Users

AttiNexis primarily serves:

* Colleges and universities
* Principals
* Training & Placement Officers
* Placement teams
* Faculty
* College Directors
* Institutional leadership

Its programs are particularly relevant to institutions seeking stronger industry alignment, student employability, placement readiness, expert engagement and corporate connections.

## Institutional Alignment

AttiNexis states that its programs are aligned with:

* NEP 2020
* Current industry and employer expectations
* Hiring trends
* AI and future workforce developments
* Student employability and placement requirements
* Industry engagement requirements

Her profile includes:

## Institutional Partnership Example

AttiNexis identifies Amrutvahini College of Engineering, Sangamner, Maharashtra as an active partner for 2025–2026.

The engagement is described as an industry engagement partnership supporting engineering students through industry context, intelligence work, expert engagement and career readiness.

## Company

AttiNexis Learning and Edtech LLP is the legal entity identified on the website.

The company describes itself as a team of five professionals spanning corporate careers, academia and industry training.

## Vision

> To become the most trusted Industry Intelligence and Employability Partner for higher education institutions in India — helping every college build a structured, ongoing connection with the world of work.
